author: KevinRevenger
quote:
GTA 6 may be one of the most expensive and ambitious games ever made, but I honestly don't understand why it deserves this almost untouchable level of hype.
For a game reportedly built with such an enormous investment, I expected much more than another return to the same formula: crime, violence, robberies, and the familiar GTA structure we've seen for decades. Of course, the level of detail and technical ambition are impressive, but impressive production values alone don't automatically make a game revolutionary.
What disappoints me even more is that, despite all the money and development behind it, the game doesn't even deliver the 60 FPS performance I would expect from a major current-generation release.
GTA 6 will undoubtedly be a massive commercial success, and I can respect the scale of what Rockstar has created. But personally, I don't think bigger budgets, bigger worlds, and bigger hype necessarily mean a better or more innovative game.

author: KevinRevenger
quote: There are games you finish, and then there are games that stay with you. For me, this belongs to the second **** original game was a huge part of my childhood, and it is one of those titles I still remember with great affection. I have always considered it an incredibly well-crafted and special experience.That is why being able to return to this game after so many years through this new version has been incredible. The new designs are much more beautiful, the visuals are more refined, and at the same time, the essence of the game that defined such an important part of my childhood is still **** one of the things that surprised me the most is something that wasn't in the original: the new mechanic that allows you to actually play an instrument and have what you play reflected in the game itself. I absolutely love this idea. It genuinely got me excited and added an entirely new dimension to an experience I already loved.There is something really special about seeing a game that was such an important part of your childhood return so many years later and realizing that it doesn't need to rely on nostalgia to still be great. This new version respects everything I loved about the original while managing to make the experience even better, more beautiful, and richer through meaningful new ideas.Ocarina of Time doesn't need to prove its importance. It's a game that has transcended generations and left an undeniable mark on the history of video games. But for me, that history has always been personal as well. It was part of my childhood, helped shape my passion for video games, and became one of those experiences I have never forgotten. Being able to return to this world after so many years, now renewed, more beautiful, and filled with new ideas, feels incredibly special. It's like rediscovering a part of my childhood and realizing that there are still new reasons to fall in love with it all over again.
